```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

##process Ti_IMAC
```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Read and preprocess the Ti_IMAC data
Ti_IMAC <- read_csv("Ti_IMAC.csv")
Ti_IMAC <- Ti_IMAC %>%
  dplyr::select(File, Protein_Name, Number_Site_Specific_Glycan)

# Convert to wide format
wide_Ti_IMAC <- Ti_IMAC %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = File, values_from = Number_Site_Specific_Glycan, names_prefix = "num_site_specific_glycans_")

# Filter out rows with NA values
Ti_IMAC_noNA <- wide_Ti_IMAC %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

# Calculate average and standard deviation for each protein
Ti_IMAC_stats <- Ti_IMAC_noNA %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    avg_site_specific_glycans_Ti_IMAC = mean(c_across(starts_with("num_site_specific_glycans_")), na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_site_specific_glycans_Ti_IMAC  = sd(c_across(starts_with("num_site_specific_glycans_")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(Protein_Name, avg_site_specific_glycans_Ti_IMAC, sd_site_specific_glycans_Ti_IMAC)

```

##merge and plot
```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Merge all conditions
merged_stats <- Ti_IMAC_stats %>%
  inner_join(PolyA_rep1_stats, by = "Protein_Name") %>%
  inner_join(PolyA_rep2_stats, by = "Protein_Name")

write.table(merged_stats, "merged_protein_stats.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

top_indices <- order(PolyA_rep1_stats$avg_site_specific_glycans_PolyA_rep1, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
top_proteins <- PolyA_rep1_stats$Protein_Name[top_indices]

# Reshape and filter only top 20 proteins
long_stats <- merged_stats %>%
  filter(Protein_Name %in% top_proteins) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("avg_site_specific_glycans"),
               names_to = "Condition",
               values_to = "avg_site_specific_glycans") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sd_site_specific_glycans"),
               names_to = "Condition_sd",
               values_to = "sd_site_specific_glycans") %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = str_replace(Condition, "avg_site_specific_", ""),
    Condition_sd = str_replace(Condition_sd, "sd_site_specific_", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(Condition == Condition_sd) %>%
  mutate(Protein_Name = factor(Protein_Name, levels = top_proteins)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition_sd)

# Create the point plot with error bars
plot <- ggplot(long_stats, aes(x = avg_site_specific_glycans, y = reorder(Protein_Name, avg_site_specific_glycans), color = Condition)) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = avg_site_specific_glycans - sd_site_specific_glycans,
                     xmax = avg_site_specific_glycans + sd_site_specific_glycans), height = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Mean Site-Specific Glycans", y = "Protein Name",
       color = "Condition") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(long_stats$avg_site_specific_glycans, na.rm = TRUE), by = 25)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = -5)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


# Save the plot
ggsave("protein_avg_site_specific_glycans_with_error_bars.svg", plot, width = 3.5, height = 2, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
